title: I have been re-watching the West Wing a lot in the past week 🤣 #broad...
transcript: We had a blue wave in America last week, and I can't prove it, but I'm pretty sure at least 1% of the reason is because the Bartlett administration is taking over Broadway. We have not one, not two, but three members of The West Wing cast in this New York theatrical season, which is kind of wild and amazing. First off, we got our girl, our beloved CJ Cregg In other desert cities. Allison Janey is so funny in the show, I can't get over it. A few good men is first off written by Mr. Aaron Sorkin himself and stars Bradley Whitford, our Josh Lyman. Haven't seen this yet. I'm taking my dad in December cause this is the most dad show ever and I cannot wait. And then announced just this morning, Toby Richard Schiff is going to be in awake and sing, which starts on Broadway in December. As someone who grew up on The West Wing, who will forever and always love it, who rewatches it often, it is a great time to be a theatre kid. We'll have about a month where all three of these shows are playing on Broadway at the same time. So, West Wing fans let's plan for the ultimate three show weekend. What a great week it's been.
classificationReason: Covers 3 different Broadway shows featuring West Wing cast members (Other Desert Cities, A Few Good Men, Awake and Sing) with no single show as the primary focus
